newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV WINS FOURTH TITLE OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV WINS FOURTH TITLE OF THE YEAR.

text.p: French Open champion Yevgeny Kafelnikov won his fourth title of the year on Sunday when he beat Frenchman Arnaud Boetsch 7-5 6-3 in the final of the Lyon grand prix.
The Russian second seed was always in command after coming back from 5-3 down in the first set. He had his service broken in the third game.
"Every year I've made progress here...," said the world number five, who reached the Lyon quarter-finals in 1994 and the semifinals last year.
"For me, after Roland Garros, it's always a pleasure to play in France," added Kafelnikov, who has also won in Adelaide and Prague this year.
Unseeded Boetsch, whose form has shown a marked improvement since he helped France reach the Davis Cup final at the expense of Italy last month, served for the first set at 5-4.
But his first service, so true when he upset fifth-seeded Swede Thomas Eqvist in their semifinal, failed him.
Kafelnikov was on top from that moment, winning his serves with something to spare, while Boetsch was always in trouble on his and a double fault allowed his opponent to go 4-2 ahead.
